title: Anthropic’s near-$2tn IPO rests on a revenue forecast for 2028
excerpt: Anthropic’s IPO valuation reportedly hinges on an internal forecast of $190bn-$200bn in 2028 revenue, a two-years-forward bet that only holds if the AI boom does.
content_html:
According to a Reuters exclusive, the AI lab’s initial public offering hinges on an internal forecast that it will book between $190bn and $200bn of revenue in 2028, a previously unreported figure that bankers and investors are already leaning on to justify a price tag that could brush $2tn.

The leap involved is the sort that only makes sense inside a boom. Anthropic’s revenue run rate sat at roughly $47bn as of May 2026, up from about $9bn at the end of 2025, so the reported 2028 target implies revenue more than quadrupling again in a little over two years.

The near-term numbers are, admittedly, moving fast. Second-quarter revenue for 2026 is projected to reach at least $10.9bn, more than double the previous quarter, and the company is said to be eyeing its first quarterly operating profit, a forecast figure of around $559m.

For a lab that has spent most of its life burning cash, that would be a genuine inflection point, and it is the kind of trajectory that lets bankers argue the forecasts are not fantasy but extrapolation.

Rather than pricing Anthropic on what it earns today, bankers are reportedly applying enterprise-value-to-revenue multiples to those 2028 forecasts, a two-years-forward approach that is rare in public markets but was used before the flotations of Cerebras and SpaceX. It is a method built for companies growing too quickly to value on the present tense.

Palantir trades at roughly 53 times its expected 2026 revenue, while SpaceX and Cloudflare sit at around 41.6 times. Stretch multiples like those across Anthropic’s projected 2028 haul and the eye-watering headline figures begin to look, if not sober, then at least internally consistent.

The catch is that the whole calculation borrows heavily from the future, and it assumes the enthusiasm on display today survives long enough to meet the revenue it is pricing in.

Not everyone is convinced they would hold. “Could they get a $2 trillion valuation, yeah they could and I just wonder if it would stay there over time,” said David Merkel of Aleph Investments, neatly capturing the gap between what a hot market will pay on the day and what it will tolerate a year later.

The caveat sits in the cost base. Heavy spending on GPUs, compute and model training is pressing on current margins, and the bull case rests on the assumption that those costs fall as a share of revenue as the business scales.

If they do not, the two-years-forward logic starts to wobble, because the whole exercise trades present profitability for future size.

The valuation talk has been climbing for months. Anthropic has already attracted investor offers at an $800bn valuation and been reported to be eyeing something closer to $900bn in a mooted $50bn round, with the IPO chatter now nudging toward the $2tn mark that once sounded fanciful.

The wider risk is that the whole edifice depends on a forecast holding in a market that could turn. Cheaper rivals are already threatening the economics that underpin these valuations, and a two-years-forward multiple is only ever as good as the year it is pointed at.

For now, the story is the sort that raises a European eyebrow: dazzling growth, real questions about margins, and a valuation resting almost entirely on a number nobody can yet check.

Anthropic may well hit $200bn in revenue by 2028, and its recent run of results gives the ambition more credibility than it once had. But the market is being asked to price the company as though that arrival is already booked, and to do so two full years before the receipts come in.

content_html_zh:
据路透社独家报道，该人工智能实验室的首次公开募股取决于内部预测，即该实验室到 2028 年的收入将在 1900 亿美元至 2000 亿美元之间，银行家和投资者已经在依靠这一此前未报道的数字来证明其可能刷到 2 万亿美元的价格标签的合理性。

所涉及的飞跃只有在繁荣时期才有意义。 截至 2026 年 5 月，Anthropic 的收入运行率约为 470 亿美元，高于 2025 年底的约 90 亿美元，因此报告的 2028 年目标意味着收入在两年多一点的时间内再次翻两番以上。

诚然，近期的数字正在快速变化。 预计 2026 年第二季度收入将至少达到 109 亿美元，是上一季度的两倍多，据称该公司正着眼于第一季度营业利润，预计约为 5.59 亿美元。

对于一个一生大部分时间都在烧钱的实验室来说，这将是一个真正的拐点，正是这种轨迹让银行家们认为这些预测不是幻想而是推断。

据报道，银行家们并没有按照 Anthropic 今天的盈利来定价，而是将企业价值与收入的倍数用于 2028 年的预测，这种未来两年的方法在公开市场上很少见，但在 Cerebras 和 SpaceX 上市之前就曾使用过。 这是一种为那些发展过快而无法重视现在时的公司而建立的方法。

Palantir 的市盈率约为 2026 年预期收入的 53 倍，而 SpaceX 和 Cloudflare 的市盈率约为 41.6 倍。 像 Anthropic 预计的 2028 年运输量那样的拉伸倍数和令人眼花缭乱的标题数据开始看起来，如果不是清醒的，那么至少在内部是一致的。

问题在于，整个计算大量借鉴了未来，并且假设今天表现出的热情能够持续足够长的时间来满足其定价的收入。

并非所有人都相信自己会持有。 Aleph Investments 的戴维·默克尔 (David Merkel) 表示：“他们能否获得 2 万亿美元的估值，是的，他们可以，我只是想知道随着时间的推移，这种估值是否会保持在这个水平。”他巧妙地捕捉到了热门市场当天的支付价格与一年后的承受价格之间的差距。

需要注意的是成本基础。 GPU、计算和模型训练方面的大量支出正在挤压当前的利润率，而牛市的假设是随着业务规模的扩大，这些成本占收入的比例会下降。

如果他们不这样做，那么两年前的逻辑就会开始动摇，因为整个练习交易都呈现出未来规模的盈利能力。

几个月来，估值讨论一直在升温。 Anthropic 已经以 8000 亿美元的估值吸引了投资者的报价，据报道，它正在考虑在 500 亿美元的融资中考虑接近 9000 亿美元的估值，而 IPO 的传言现在正在向 2 万亿美元大关迈进，这曾经听起来有些天方夜谭。

更广泛的风险是，整个大厦取决于对可能转变的市场的预测。 更便宜的竞争对手已经威胁到支撑这些估值的经济状况，而未来两年的市盈率只能与它所指出的年份一样好。

目前，这个故事让欧洲人感到惊讶：令人眼花缭乱的增长、关于利润率的真正问题、以及几乎完全基于无人能核实的数字的估值。

到 2028 年，Anthropic 的收入很可能会达到 2000 亿美元，而其最近的一系列业绩使这一雄心比以前更加可信。 但市场被要求对该公司进行定价，就像已经预订了该公司一样，并且在收到收据之前整整两年这样做。
